one_liner: Works on the health of whole populations, not one patient at a time.
Looks after people who cannot fully look after themselves - at home, daily, in person.

Works out what a company or an investment is really worth.

Manages other people's money and advises them where to put it.

Studies how money, work and policy move through a whole economy.
Argues and advises on what the law allows, requires and forbids.
Makes sure a company follows the law it is required to follow.

Sits as a judge in the district courts and decides cases.
Researches and designs the rules and programmes governments run on.

The crew that makes a shoot physically happen - rigging, grip, power, sets, studio floor.

Writes and builds the music itself - for film, advertising, artists and their own releases.
Performs and creates dance - classical, film, contemporary, folk and commercial.
Plays a part in front of an audience or a camera - stage, screen, television or ad film.

Makes a live show work - sound, lights, rigging, staging and the running of the event.
